SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS Lowest_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Age Group" = '5-17';

SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS LowestFreeRate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0;

SELECT 
    MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS LowestRate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    `Age Group` = '5-17';

SELECT MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS LowestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
WHERE "School Type" = 'Continuation Schools'
ORDER BY "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)"
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.CDSCode, T1.School, T1.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY T1.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    schools.SchoolType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT

SELECT

    schools ON frpm.School_Name = schools.School

    frpm.School_Type = 'Continuation High Schools'

SELECT 
    MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS Lowest_Free_Rate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
LIMIT 3;
